Container.Name: ada
Container.Overview: Ada, a personal AI assistant (Claude API or a free local Ollama model) you chat with on Telegram. She can check and manage your server, write code, and asks before changing anything.

Config.Name: Claude API key
Config.Description: Optional. From console.anthropic.com. Leave empty to use the free local model (Ollama).

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Address of your Ollama container: your Unraid server's IP, port 11434

Config.Name: Ollama model
Config.Description: Local model to use. It must support tools (qwen3, llama3.1, mistral-nemo...)

Config.Name: Ollama thinking
Config.Description: true lets thinking models (qwen3) reason before answering: smarter but much slower

Config.Name: Ollama keep loaded
Config.Description: How long the model stays in memory after a message (e.g. 30m, 2h, -1 = forever)

Config.Name: Brain
Config.Description: claude or ollama. Empty = Claude if an API key is set, otherwise Ollama

Config.Name: Your Telegram user ID
Config.Description: Only this user can talk to Ada. Get it from @userinfobot.

Config.Name: Effort
Config.Description: low, medium, high: higher thinks harder and costs more

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets Ada see and manage your containers

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Ada's work folder (code projects go here)

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Lets Ada read and edit your apps' config files
